title: Home run-off fieldwork written guide and results sheet
subject: Geography
source: Written for geography/y7 lesson 18 (Home run-off fieldwork written guide and results sheet (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 18: How we use rivers; floods on the Thames; home fieldwork. Read it all first; an adult knows what you are doing.

practical.aim: To compare run-off on different surfaces
equipment: A jug of water (the same amount each time)
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Tidy up and wash your hands
method: Pour the same amount of water slowly onto grass
Time how long until it soaks in and watch for run-off
Repeat on bare soil and on a path or patio
Decide which surface has most run-off

questions.q: Big question: natural or human disaster?
questions.a: Both: heavy rain is natural, but building and paving increase run-off and risk
